title: Endurance Aventure Summer 2026: A Historic Season
excerpt: From July 23 to 26, 2026, Témiscamingue writes world sports history by hosting the ARWS Junior World Championship. An overview of an extraordinary season.
content:
From July 23 to 26, 2026, Témiscamingue will host the very first ARWS Junior Adventure Racing World Championship.

Like every year, summer brings its share of adventures, discoveries, encounters, and expeditions. But this season is entirely different for the Endurance Aventure team. For the first time in over 25 years of existence, we have chosen to pause the majority of our standard events to devote all our energy to a landmark project: organizing the inaugural Junior World Championship of the Adventure Racing World Series (ARWS).

An ambitious project. A deeply human project. A project that mirrors our values, and above all, a project that will showcase Quebec, Témiscamingue, and our entire community of adventurers on the international stage.

Organized by Endurance Aventure in close collaboration with the Société de développement du Témiscamingue (SDT), this historic event will bring together 40 teams representing 10+ countries. These teams didn't get here by chance: the vast majority had to qualify through rigorous national championships or earn selection by their national federation to officially represent their country.

For four consecutive days, the world's elite young adventurers aged 16 to 25 will go head-to-head on an epic wilderness course combining orienteering, trekking, mountain biking, canoeing, navigation, and teamwork. More than just a race, this championship is a true celebration of exploration, resilience, collaboration, and camaraderie.

We need your energy and support. The inaugural Junior World Championship is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to experience world-class racing from the inside and give back to the next generation what adventure sports have given you over the years.

By joining our volunteer crew, you will directly help deliver an unforgettable experience to youth from across the globe, as well as many Quebecers and Canadians sharing your passion.

Whether at athlete hospitality, logistics, course marshalling, transition zones, safety patrol, or team support, your involvement makes all the difference. In years to come, you will be able to proudly say: "I was there. I helped organize the very first Junior World Adventure Racing Championship." Come make history with us.

title: ARWS Junior World Championship: Delegations from 11 Nations Ready for the Start
excerpt: From the USA to New Zealand, 11 national delegations are converging on Témiscamingue for the first ARWS Junior Adventure Racing World Championship.
content:
Eleven nations, one wilderness playground, and dozens of world-class young racers ready to push their limits in Témiscamingue.

Young athletes from the United States, Brazil, Uruguay, Ireland, Spain, France, Italy, South Africa, India, Australia, and New Zealand have confirmed their registration and travel plans to take on Quebec's boreal wilderness.

Each national delegation has completed intense training blocks in navigation, backcountry paddling, trail endurance, and technical rope maneuvers to prepare for the demands of the ARWS Junior World Championship.

Endurance Aventure and the municipality of Ville-Marie are rolling out the red carpet to welcome international staff, coaches, and families in a spirit of friendship and authentic outdoor community.

title: Canada Man/Woman XTRI World Tour Turns a Page to Open an Exciting New Chapter
excerpt: Looking back at the legend of Mont-Mégantic and the future of extreme triathlon with Endurance Aventure.
content:
For nearly a decade, the Canada Man/Woman extreme triathlon at Lac-Mégantic has challenged the fiercest endurance athletes on the planet.

From the dawn swim in the pitch-black waters of Lake Mégantic to the brutal bike climbs of the Appalachian ridges and the haunting final marathon ascending to the summit observatory of Mont-Mégantic, the race redefined what it means to be an extreme triathlete.

As Endurance Aventure embarks on new global challenges, we celebrate every finisher, volunteer, and supporter who etched their names into the legendary history of North America's premier XTRI World Tour event.

title: The 2025 Edition of GBC 500: A Truly 'Perfect Storm'!
excerpt: A festival of fall colors, summer heat, and absolute endurance: complete recap of the 2025 Gravel Bikepacking Challenge 500.
content:
Dear gravel and bikepacking enthusiasts,

What can we say about the 2025 edition of GBC 500? A dazzling explosion of autumn colors, an unforgettable challenge, and an extraordinary experience! All the ingredients came together for something magical: crisp dry weather, summer temperatures, and crystal-clear blue skies—a truly perfect storm!

Across four days of self-supported and supported bikepacking, cyclists tackled distances of 100 km, 250 km, and the full 500 km epic, weaving through rolling country roads, dense maple ridges, and hidden river valleys.

Our photographers were on the ground at every turn to capture the grit, smiles, and triumph of every single finisher crossing the line.
